question: Does a continuous hexagon-shape statistic of the Voronoi cells (fitted regular-hexagon IoU, the point-only analogue of the challenge's HEX definition) carry more HEX information than the six-neighbour fraction?
evaluation: LOFO blend vs HEX as before; 20 leaked rows excluded
pre_specified_decision: primary HEX<-sg2:hexiou_mean; gate -0.09 pp HEX and >= 2 folds; any other feature that beats the primary is exploratory and must be re-confirmed on the seed-47/48 detectors before use
falsification: hexiou no better than frac_sides6 means the shape detail beyond neighbour count is noise at this detection quality
